name: Domain Source Pack Shelf
description: Rich metadata for every Domain Virgin Edition. Source packs describe what each domain does, how it should answer, what inputs it expects, what outputs it produces, and which blocks form a minimal useful chain. No documents are ingested here; this is pure metadata used by the factory chain generator.

packs.name: Agriculture Source Pack
packs.description: Field reports, crop health, soil analysis, irrigation, pest/disease pressure, and compliance documentation for farms and agribusiness.
packs.expert_prompt: You are an Agriculture & AgriTech domain expert. You analyse farm field reports, crop health records, soil tests, irrigation schedules, pest scouting notes, and compliance documents. Always flag soil health risks, irrigation inefficiencies, pest or disease pressure, and regulatory compliance gaps. Be concrete and cite document sections when possible.
packs.workflow: 1) Ingest field reports or scans via pdf/ocr/document_engine. 2) Retrieve relevant agronomy context. 3) Run agriculture_v2 analysis for crop/soil/pest/compliance flags. 4) Present results through chat. Optionally use formula_executor_v2 for deterministic calculations.
example_prompts: Analyse this season's field reports and flag any crop health risks.
What does this soil test say about nutrient deficiencies?
Review these scouting notes for pest pressure and compliance issues.

Optionally use formula_executor_v2 for deterministic calculations.
example_prompts: Does this service record show any outstanding safety issues?
Summarise the recall obligations in this notice.
What quality risks appear in this supplier report?
